# Document templates

Reusable starting points for [plans](PLAN.md), [designs](DESIGN.md), [reports](REPORT.md), and [folder READMEs](FOLDER_README.md).

Follow [the writing process](../WRITING.md); choose only what the task needs, replace prompts, and delete unused sections. GitHub templates live under [.github](../../.github/README.md).

[AGENT_PLAN.json](AGENT_PLAN.json) is an illustrative, optional task graph for the [factory helper](../AGENT_FACTORY.md#optional-offline-helper). Copy it beside a substantial plan and replace its outcome, paths, acceptance and checks. It stores dependencies and ownership, not persistent task statuses; short task tables need no JSON file.
